notes.title: Deasiege official release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676468/94f07d9ae40e16d8e0bf8c368e4e99609ddefd8c.png[/img]

First, my thanks to everyone who has gave me constructive feedback in the Early Access stage. I've been working very hard for a year to improve gameplay mechanics and optimization. After 3.5 years of development, Deadsiege is officially released today.

[b]Trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=maaGdmC7SbY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Changelogs:[/b]
- Add final map Firelands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676468/3217d5377e0a8f5e4e85173263f6ea8f71cde096.png[/img]

- Rework the Talent Tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676468/0ecade26d804077f3bb7a5f5b9db3d60cfaf0f14.png[/img]

- Vendor shop is now selling rejuvenation potions at level 12, 24, 36 and 48.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676468/7af44b3e161f5caf121ab4f93a002f37c64d9167.png[/img]

- Add new game + mode.
- Add ambience and battle music.
- Increase items and equipments price.
- Improve level up system.
- Fix Melee abilities are missed when low fps.
- Further optimization.
- Remove boxes and barrels icons on minimap and big map due to performance.
- Balance gameplay.

Thanks for playing Deadsiege.

Best Regards,
Truong Bui
Null Pointer Studio

notes.title: Deadsiege updates version 0.6
notes.content:
Changelogs:

- You can click right mouse button on a Hotbar slot to use item/ability
- Add on/off BG music option in Settings menu
- When you use a ability in right mouse button (RMB) slot, the character will rotate toward the mouse location then attack.
- Now Boots will have random Movement Speed stat depends on the equipment's quality. Common 20-40, Rare: 40-60, Epic 60-80, Legendary 80-100. 
- Maximum Movement Speed now is set to 500.
- Increase Gold from equipments.
- Some small changes in level 30 abilities.

notes.title: Update version 0.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676468/f4987d6b5adc58cd63b9150e94679e927222e85f.png[/img]
Deadsiege Early Access version 0.5 is released today.

Changelogs:
- Add a new map Icelands, new quests and monsters (Talk to Symond after defeat Mountain Dragon to travel to new map.).
- Improve the game’s performance.
- Treasure chest icons is no longer showed on map.
- Increase required experience to level up each level.
- Increase potion's price.
- Increase chances to drop rare potions from pile of boxes/barrels.
- Reduce chances to drop equipment from pile of boxes/barrels.
- Increase experience and gold bonus from Ebonden Ruins quests.
- Increase random number of items dropped from Treasure chests and bosses.
- Add a Legendary Treasure Chest at Mountain Dragon location.
- Change some level 24 and 30 abilities in the Talent Tree.
- Remove experience penalty, now you will lose (1000 * level) gold when you're dead.

notes.title: Deadsiege updates version 0.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676468/5b5680bba775f5be5cde6c76ad97dcdacc98672d.png[/img]

Change logs:
-  Rework the map system. You can toggle big map and mini map by pressing ‘M' key or click to "Toggle Map" button.
-  Add effect on dropped items.
- If there is an ability in RMB slot you can hold right mouse button down to continually attack.
- Double left click to buy x10 consumable items or instantly sell item in your inventory.
- Default showing item name UI, you can turn it off by press ‘N’ key or click to "Toggle Item Name UI" button.
- Item vendor now sell items have the same level as your.
- New type of potion will be sold when you are at level 12, 24 and 36.
- Increase gold dropped from boxes and barrels.
- You will lose 1/3 of your total next level experience if you are dead instead of losing all your current experience.

notes.title: Deadsiege updates 0.3
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.3 improved game-play pace[/b]

[b]Changelogs:[/b]

- Main character's base Physical Power and Magical Power increase to 30.
- Reduces most of skills' cooldown to 1 second, except tier 2 (level 6) ranged skills.

Best Regards,
Null Pointer Studio

notes.title: Deadsiege EA ver 0.2
notes.content:
Deadsiege updates EA version 0.2 brings some bug fixs and improving in game mechanics

Change logs:
- Town Portal now spawns at the player’s location
- Hold left mouse button (LMB) down to continuously attack or move.
- Esc button will close all windows if there is any window showing, otherwise shows option window.
- Opens/closes shop vendor window will also opens/closes inventory window.
- Show warning message if there isn’t item available in your inventory when you press hotbar button to consume the item.
- Fix bug Poison Troll stuck when come back to original location.
- Re-balance all melee and ranged abilities (from level 1-12) in Talent Tree.
- Decreases bosses's bonus stats each level.

Best Regards,
Null Pointer Studio
